# Repository Agent Requirements

All AI coding agents (including Copilot) MUST read and follow the repository-level agent guidance defined in the `AGENTS.md` file at the project root. Before making changes to code, tests, documentation, or configuration, consult `AGENTS.md` and ensure your actions comply with its rules and conventions.

If `AGENTS.md` conflicts with other instruction files, follow the process described in `AGENTS.md` for resolving conflicts and ask a human maintainer if clarification is needed.
